subject: houndeye
label: houndeye, in the place of the game's models/houndeye.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/headcrab.mdl, models/chumtoad.mdl, models/roach.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, A, B, B where the asset was C, A, B, B: told apart
measured.lineupWhy:
1. Its body is a smooth, bloated, toy-like ball with a flat top and no spines, ridges or segments, while the others have sleek or fleshy organic forms.
2. Its legs are short, straight, uniform cylinders that stand square under the body with no knees, joints, claws or taper, so it looks like it is standing on posts.
3. Its paint is a flat, uniform yellow with a dark green stripe and blotches and no gradients, veins, wounds or glow, and its single large black eye has no lids, red iris or other face detail like B.
